faqs.q: How do receipts work?
faqs.a: Staff text or email a photo when they buy. Aria AI is built to match it to the purchase, code it and attach it, so nobody chases receipts at month-end.

faqs.q: How much do we earn back?
faqs.a: 2% back on medical supplies and business spend, with no categories to track, and 5% on Aria Marketplace orders. Final rates will be set out in the card terms at launch.

faqs.q: Does it work with our accounting software?
faqs.a: Aria is built to sync with QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite and Sage Intacct, with each purchase coded to the right location and category.

faqs.q: Can Aria track what insurers owe us?
faqs.a: Yes. Aria is built to match each insurer payment to its bank deposit, flag short pays against your contracts and rank denials by dollars.
